content:
Don't want to be upstaged by the all-new Mac mini and Mac Studio, Apple today also simultaneously launched an updated version of the Polishing Cloth. In an era where everything is getting more expensive, the new polishing cloth has actually been reduced in price to US$9 (the old version was US$19).

It is currently unknown what changes have been made to the new polishing cloth. Apple's product description for the new version is the same as the old one:

Apple launched the Polishing Cloth in October 2021, and it sold out almost immediately. Although this product has become an internet meme, to be fair it really does a good job of cleaning Apple devices.

You can now order this "new" polishing cloth from the Apple website for US$9. When I tell people to hurry and place their order, I'm only half joking, because it really might well sell out.

If you want to collect a piece of Apple history, the original polishing cloth is still available on Amazon for US$19.
